faqs.a:
(a)
Definitions.
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Recyclable materials
means newspaper, magazines, cardboard, telephone books, loose paper, glass containers,
               steel cans, plastic, aluminum cans and scraps, reusable clothing, or household items.
Recycling agent
means a person who collects recyclable materials throughout the city as such materials
               appear on the curbs.
(b)
Removal of recyclable materials.
It shall be unlawful for any person, other than the person placing recyclable materials
               at the curb for collection or the designated recycling agent thereof, to take possession
               and remove from the vicinity of the curb any recyclable materials that are plainly
               marked with the name of the recycling agent for whom such recyclable materials are
               intended.
(Code 1981, § 21-34; Ord. No. 2747, § 1, 9-4-1990)
